notes: Bundled Rip Node API v0.2.9 verifies false open or empty tray reports from USB optical bridges against actual readable media capacity.
Physically closed manual-close drives can now leave Waiting for disc and auto-start after their normal silent detection delay.
Rip startup uses the verified media result instead of rejecting a loaded disc solely because its USB bridge reports Tray open.
Supports Close remains enforced end-to-end: disabled drives expose no Close control and Manager rejects close requests.
Existing storage-location, scanner, drive-mapping and simulator-visibility fixes are preserved; installation remains manual-only.
